# Acme Health Third-Party AI System Risk Management Standard

## 1. Purpose and Scope

This standard establishes requirements for managing risks and benefits associated with third-party artificial intelligence (AI) software, data, and systems within Acme Health.

This standard applies to all AI systems that incorporate third-party components, including third-party AI software, third-party data, pre-trained models, and AI system components obtained through the supply chain.

## 2. Governance and Policy

2.1. Acme Health must establish and maintain policies and procedures to address AI risks and benefits arising from third-party software and data and other supply chain issues, including risks associated with third-party entities and infringement of third-party intellectual property or other rights. [NIST AI RMF Govern 6 | NIST AI RMF Govern 6.1]

## 3. Risk Mapping and Assessment

3.1. Risks and benefits must be mapped for all components of the AI system including third-party software and data. [NIST AI RMF Map 4]

3.2. Approaches for mapping AI technology and legal risks of AI system components – including the use of third-party data or software – must be in place, followed, and documented, including documentation of risks of infringement of a third party's intellectual property or other rights. [NIST AI RMF Map 4.1]

## 4. Risk Controls

4.1. Internal risk controls for components of the AI system, including third-party AI technologies, must be identified and documented. [NIST AI RMF Map 4.2]

## 5. Monitoring and Maintenance

5.1. AI risks and benefits from third-party resources must be regularly monitored, and risk controls must be applied and documented. [NIST AI RMF Manage 3 | NIST AI RMF Manage 3.1]

5.2. Pre-trained models which are used for development must be monitored as part of AI system regular monitoring and maintenance. [NIST AI RMF Manage 3.2]

## 6. Contingency Planning

6.1. Contingency processes must be in place to handle failures or incidents in third-party data or AI systems deemed to be high-risk. [NIST AI RMF Govern 6.2]
